description:
The history of one file, oldest first: `receipts` (every save of ANY file: size, SHA-256 fingerprint,
        who, when) and, for markdown records with a YAML header, `versions` (fields and body of each). Shows how a
        requirement evolved, and proves what a deliverable was at each save.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: The file whose saves and versions you want.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: file_history
